change_policy.patch: documentation or visualization changes that do not alter eligibility or outcomes
change_policy.minor: a preregistered calibration-method change using new validation data
change_policy.major: any change to required sequence, invalidation, target, deadline, outcome, or playbook set

playbooks.thesis: Accepted higher-timeframe direction produces an efficient 5m displacement, an intact first pullback, and a 1m reacceptance trigger before delivery to visible external liquidity.

required_sequence.description: 4H displacement and 1H swing progression support the same direction.
A direction-aligned 5m impulse is strong enough to establish the setup clock.
The first pullback develops after the impulse without breaching the causal invalidation.
The completed 1m path holds the trigger in the thesis direction after the pullback.

phase_rules.inactive: No registered sequence has started, or support remains below the forming gate.
phase_rules.forming: At least the directional context exists, but the plan or armed support is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: A causal plan exists and support is armed, while the registered trigger sequence is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: An aligned displacement exists and the model is waiting for an intact first pullback or trigger.
phase_rules.executable: All required sequence steps are causally ordered and the calibrated executable gate is met.
phase_rules.entered: A risk-approved order filled after the decision clock.
phase_rules.weakening: The frozen thesis remains open but calibrated support falls below its management gate.
phase_rules.delivering: The open thesis has positive delivery progress without changing its original invalidation.
phase_rules.completed: A registered target is delivered before invalidation and deadline; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later setup starts.
phase_rules.invalidated: The frozen structural invalidation is breached, the setup expires, or a terminal contradiction is registered; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later setup starts.

targets.selection: nearest reachable level in the thesis direction, with up to two further audit targets

deadline.rule: no later than the registered session deadline

playbooks.thesis: A visible external-liquidity sweep fails to continue, is reaccepted from on 5m, and establishes a 1m reversal trigger toward opposing visible liquidity.

required_sequence.description: A decision-time visible external level is swept on the thesis invalidation side.
A completed 5m bar reaccepts away from the swept side.
The completed 1m path holds a reversal trigger after reacceptance.

phase_rules.inactive: No qualifying external-liquidity sweep is active.
phase_rules.forming: A qualifying sweep exists but reacceptance, plan provenance, or support is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: The swept level, structural invalidation, target and support are present while the trigger is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: The sweep is active and the model waits for post-sweep reacceptance or the reversal trigger.
phase_rules.executable: Sweep, reacceptance and trigger occur in causal order and the calibrated executable gate is met.
phase_rules.entered: A risk-approved reversal order filled after the decision clock.
phase_rules.weakening: The frozen reversal thesis remains open but reacceptance evidence weakens.
phase_rules.delivering: Price progresses toward opposing liquidity without rewriting the sweep invalidation.
phase_rules.completed: The registered opposing-liquidity target is delivered before invalidation and deadline; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later sweep starts.
phase_rules.invalidated: Price accepts beyond the frozen sweep extreme, the setup expires, or a terminal contradiction is registered; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later sweep starts.

invalidation.source: observed sweep extreme on the thesis invalidation side

targets.selection: nearest reachable opposing level, not the realized future touch

deadline.rule: no later than the registered session deadline

playbooks.thesis: An auction beyond a dealing-range side fails to gain acceptance, returns into value on completed bars, and establishes a 1m path toward a causal value or opposing-liquidity target.

required_sequence.description: A rejection or sweep identifies an attempted auction beyond the relevant range side.
Completed 1H/5m evidence points back into the prior dealing range.
The completed 1m structural path orders toward value after reacceptance.

phase_rules.inactive: No qualifying failed-auction event is active.
phase_rules.forming: A failed-auction candidate exists but return-to-value evidence or a causal plan is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: The failure, plan and support are present while the path trigger is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: The failed auction is active and the model waits for acceptance back to value or the 1m path trigger.
phase_rules.executable: Failure, acceptance and 1m path occur in causal order and the calibrated executable gate is met.
phase_rules.entered: A risk-approved value-return order filled after the decision clock.
phase_rules.weakening: The frozen value-return thesis remains open but acceptance back to value weakens.
phase_rules.delivering: Price progresses toward the registered value/liquidity target without rewriting invalidation.
phase_rules.completed: The registered value/liquidity target is delivered before invalidation and deadline; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later failure starts.
phase_rules.invalidated: Price gains acceptance beyond the frozen failure extreme, the setup expires, or a terminal contradiction is registered; this terminal acknowledgement lasts one causal update before inactive unless a later failure starts.

invalidation.source: observed failure or sweep extreme on the thesis invalidation side

targets.source: decision-time unswept opposing-liquidity inventory; dealing-range value remains context until represented by a registered causal level
targets.selection: nearest reachable registered liquidity destination, not the realized future touch

deadline.rule: no later than the registered session deadline
